name: The Spellbound Table
prompt: Edit this Tavern Brawl gameplay concept only to correct the game geometry and hand. Preserve its composition, polished dark stone table, teal magic inlays, centered heroes, gold-white spell arc, lighting and art style. Each side must have EXACTLY THREE CREW PLACES TOTAL. Upper row: remove the empty place at far left and empty place at far right; keep the three occupied owl cards, spread and center those three across the table. Lower row: keep the fox, hare and raven cards; remove the additional empty place at far right; center the three occupied cards. Do not add any other card-shaped recesses to the playing surface. The bottom hand should contain exactly five named cards: Tavern Rat cost 1, Hare Runner cost 1, Pilfer cost 1, Rusty Dagger cost 1, and Vesper, Blackpaw King cost 6 attack 5 health 5 with text "Skirmish. Setup: gain Ward." Replace the current split Vesper/Blackpaw King hand cards with the one black-furred feline rogue king in a cloak and crown. Maintain an elegant broad five-card fan at the lower edge. This is a concept illustration; preserve all other details.
initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render a complete premium desktop web card-battle game screen for TAVERN BRAWL, landscape 16:10, edge to edge with no browser or device. Original anthropomorphic fox, owl, raven and hare fantasy cast. Player Fox duels Owl using two opposing rows of exactly three crew places, health, energy, a hand and shared coin pot. No new lanes or mechanics. UI content is a synthetic mid-match visualization of existing mechanics.
Concept B: THE SPELLBOUND TABLE. The entire table is an enchanted blue-black stone inset in an old midnight tavern, glowing teal hairline inlays joining the two sides. Strong camera depth, striking restrained atmosphere, fantasy painterly illustration with cinematic polish comparable to Legends of Runeterra. A battle-first screen with the top and bottom hero portraits centered on the same axis, concealed opponent cards compact and high. Enemy crew occupy the upper half; friendly crew the lower half; one empty place on each side. Three slots on each side only. Show an active spell as the one spectacular focal moment: a sharp arc of gold-white magic travels from a raised hand card toward the opposing crew, impact lighting physically reflecting on the nearby playing surface. The remaining screen stays clear and readable.
Cards are elegant dark collectible objects with enormous painterly art, thin antique-gold trim and high-contrast cost/attack/health badges, minimal lower text, all visibly distinct. Fanned hand along the lower edge: Tavern Rat, Hare Runner, Pilfer, Rusty Dagger, Vesper, Blackpaw King; Vesper cost 6, attack 5, health 5, Skirmish. Setup: gain Ward. Cast original fox/hare/raven crew with strong individual silhouettes. Owl hero 24 health above, Fox hero 21 below. Energy 6/8 is an elegant series of gems near lower right. Shared coin pot 3 sits on left rail. End turn on right rail, Menu, History, Rules small at upper edge, subtle Tavern Brawl identity. No huge foreground mugs, no thick baroque frames or parchment slabs, no illegible tiny card art, no uniform glowing rectangles. Rich nocturnal blues and ink teal, candle amber at the periphery, ivory lettering, finely worked brass; no generic dashboard or game menu. A fully playable-looking in-game composition with a single dramatic magic moment, not a poster.
note: Concept illustration; live rules text, card values and interaction must come from the existing engine. No approval or gameplay implementation implied.
